# The Decor Party — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & AI Specification

## 1. Brand Identity & Service Mission
The Decor Party (operated by The Decor Party Event Services Private Limited) is Bengaluru's premier celebration styling, balloon art, and surprise planning agency. Founded to bridge the gap between amateur balloon decorators and high-end luxury event productions, The Decor Party provides transparent tiered pricing, verified on-site stylists, 100% picture-match accuracy, and same-day express setup slots across Bangalore.

- **Studio Address**: Kanakapura Main Rd, near Banashankari Metro Station, Shakambari Nagar, 1st Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070
- **Primary Geolocation**: 12.91439° N, 77.57399° E
- **Official Portal**: https://thedecorparty.com
- **Customer Support & WhatsApp**: +91 70220 58460 / +91 79755 81697
- **Support Email**: info@thedecorparty.com

---

## 2. Serviceable Bengaluru Neighborhoods & Zones
The Decor Party deploys local mobile styling teams stationed throughout Bengaluru to guarantee prompt arrival and minimal transit delays:
- **Central Bengaluru**: MG Road, Brigade Road, Richmond Town, Lavelle Road, Vasanth Nagar, Malleshwaram, Sadashivnagar, Rajajinagar, Frazer Town, Ulsoor.
- **East Bengaluru**: Indiranagar, HAL, Domlur, CV Raman Nagar, Marathahalli, Whitefield, Kadugodi, Varthur, Brookfield, KR Puram.
- **South Bengaluru**: Koramangala (all blocks), HSR Layout (Sectors 1 to 7), BTM Layout, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Banashankari, Electronic City (Phases 1 & 2), Bellandur, Sarjapur Road, Haralur, Bannerghatta Road, Uttarahalli, Kanakapura Road.
- **North Bengaluru**: Hebbal, RT Nagar, Sahakar Nagar, Yelahanka, Thanisandra, Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, HBR Layout, Jakkur, Vidyaranyapura.

## 3. Detailed Package Catalog & Pricing Tiers

### Package Tier 1: Basic / Intimate Room Decor (₹3,999 – ₹6,999)
- **Best For**: Intimate bedroom surprises, apartment living rooms, budget birthdays, anniversary wake-up surprises.
- **Inclusions**:
  - 100 to 150 premium metallic / pastel latex balloons (ceiling balloons with ribbons + floor clusters).
  - Foil bunting banner ("HAPPY BIRTHDAY" or "HAPPY ANNIVERSARY").
  - Fairy light curtain or ambient LED fairy string lights (20 meters).
  - 2 foil heart/star balloons or age number foil balloons (32-inch).
  - Setup duration: 60 to 90 minutes.

### Package Tier 2: Signature Balloon Arch & Backdrop (₹7,999 – ₹12,999)
- **Best For**: Living room feature walls, clubhouse parties, kids birthday centerpieces.
- **Inclusions**:
  - Circular or square metal backdrop ring (6ft to 7ft diameter).
  - Multi-tonal organic balloon garland (200+ balloons: matte, chrome, pastel shades).
  - Acrylic disc or fabric backdrop banner with personalized vinyl lettering.
  - 1 warm white LED neon sign ("Happy Birthday", "Better Together", "Oh Baby", "Let's Party").
  - 1 cylinder cake pedestal table.
  - Setup duration: 2 hours.

### Package Tier 3: Grand Milestone Birthday / Kids Theme (₹14,999 – ₹24,999)
- **Best For**: 1st birthdays, Sweet 16, 21st / 30th / 50th milestone celebrations, society party halls.
- **Inclusions**:
  - Double layered arch frame (curved arch + circular disc).
  - 350+ organic balloons with custom color matching (double-stuffed matte balloons).
  - 3 themed cylinder plinths/cake tables with vinyl graphics.
  - 4-foot illuminated LED marquee numbers (e.g., "1", "18", "25", "30", "50").
  - Themed character cutouts (Jungle safari, Space astronaut, Cocomelon, Peppa Pig, Marvel, Princess).
  - Artificial floral sprays & pampas grass accents.
  - Setup duration: 2.5 to 3 hours.

### Package Tier 4: Romantic Rooftop Cabana & Terrace Dinner (₹8,999 – ₹18,999)
- **Best For**: Marriage proposals, wedding anniversaries, milestone date nights, Valentine's surprises.
- **Inclusions**:
  - 8x8 ft freestanding wooden/iron cabana frame draped with sheer ivory chiffon curtains.
  - Ceiling fairy light canopy (over 500 micro-LED warm lights).
  - Floor candle pathway (20 to 40 glass hurricane lanterns with flameless LED pillar candles).
  - Fresh red rose petal bed styling and pathway trail.
  - Low-seating bohemian setup with plush rug, bolster cushions, and Moroccan poufs, OR styled romantic dining table with table runner, candleholders, and fine cutlery.
  - Setup duration: 2.5 to 3 hours.

### Package Tier 5: "MARRY ME" Grand Proposal Setup (₹18,999 – ₹34,999)
- **Best For**: High-impact marriage proposals on terraces, resort lawns, or private banquet rooms.
- **Inclusions**:
  - 4-foot giant warm-white illuminated marquee letters spelling "MARRY ME".
  - Red carpet or ivory aisle runner flanked by floral bouquets and candle jars.
  - Neon sign options: "Will You Marry Me?", "Forever & Always".
  - Large heart-shaped archway styled with red roses and baby's breath.
  - 2 cold-spark cold pyrotechnic fountains (for the exact proposal moment).
  - Ambient Bluetooth sound speaker ready with romantic playlist.
  - Setup duration: 3 to 4 hours.

### Package Tier 6: Baby Shower & Cradle Ceremony / Namkaran (₹12,999 – ₹28,999)
- **Best For**: Mom-to-be celebrations, newborn homecoming, traditional cradle naming ceremony.
- **Inclusions**:
  - Traditional or contemporary floral cradle decoration (fresh jasmine, marigold, carnations, baby's breath).
  - Pastel gender-neutral organic arch (sage green, peach, blush, cream, gold chrome).
  - "Welcome Baby [Name]" or "Baby Shower" personalized wooden nameplate.
  - Mom-to-be throne chair or styled sofa seating.
  - Setup duration: 2.5 hours.

## 4. Activities, Entertainment & Gourmet Add-Ons
Customers can add any of the following professional entertainment artists and live food stalls directly to their booking:
- **Tattoo Artist**: Water-resistant temporary tattoos & glitter tattoos for children and adults (₹2,499 for 2 hours, unlimited tattoos).
- **Magician**: Interactive comedy magic show with audience participation and trick reveals (₹3,999 for 45-60 min stage/parlor show).
- **Face Painting**: Skin-safe non-toxic FDA-approved body face paint with superhero, animal, and fantasy designs (₹2,499 for 2 hours).
- **Balloon Modelling**: Skilled balloon artist sculpting swords, animals, crowns, and flowers on demand (₹2,499 for 2 hours).
- **Mascot Artist**: Costume performer (Mickey, Donald, Lion, Teddy Bear, Superhero) for photo-ops and welcoming guests (₹2,999 for 2 hours).
- **Gourmet Popcorn Machine**: Live buttered/salted cinema popcorn cart with bags (₹2,499 for 50-70 servings).
- **Cotton Candy Floss Cart**: Fresh pink & blue spun sugar on sticks (₹2,499 for 50-70 servings).
- **3-Tier Chocolate Fountain**: Warm Belgian milk chocolate with fresh marshmallows and fruit skewers (₹4,499 for 50 guests).
- **Instant Photo Booth / Caricature Artist**: Live hand-drawn caricatures or instant magnetic polaroids for take-home souvenirs.
- **Event Photographer / Videographer**: 2-hour event coverage with 50+ color-graded high-resolution photos and reels (₹4,999).

---

## 5. Booking Workflow & Logistics Protocols
1. **Selection & Customization**: User browses packages on the website or uses the AI Event Planner to define their theme, guest count, and budget.
2. **Add-on Configuration**: Select add-ons such as live popcorn machines, magicians, photography, or cake pedestals.
3. **Date & Slot Scheduling**: Pick celebration date and setup window (Morning 9:00-12:00, Afternoon 13:00-16:00, Evening 17:00-20:00, or Midnight 22:30-00:30).
4. **Checkout & Payment**: Secure advance booking via Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Cards, NetBanking).
5. **Stylist Dispatch**: Customer receives stylist contact details, arrival verification, and gate pass assistance 3 hours prior to the slot.
6. **Setup Completion & Sign-off**: Decorators set up, test lighting, clean up all discarded packaging/waste, and hand over the space in pristine condition.

---

## 6. Safety, Sustainability & Quality Standards
- **Balloon Quality**: We use 100% natural biodegradable latex balloons derived from rubber trees that decompose in nature over 6-12 months.
- **No Damaging Adhesives**: We use surface-safe painter's tape, removable hooks, and weighted frames to ensure walls, wallpapers, and venue ceilings remain completely undamaged.
- **Clean Air / Electric Pumps**: We never use hazardous or combustible gases. All balloon inflation is handled with electric filtered air pumps. Helium is strictly supplied via certified non-flammable inert helium cylinders only upon explicit request.
- **Clean-up Guarantee**: Our team removes all balloon clips, balloon tie strips, and protective plastic before leaving your premises.

---

## 7. Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
- **Free Cancellation**: Full refund (minus nominal 3% payment gateway processing fee) if canceled at least 48 hours prior to the booked setup slot.
- **Rescheduling**: Free rescheduling allowed up to 24 hours prior to the event, valid for up to 90 days from the original date.
- **Weather Contingency for Terraces/Outdoors**: In case of rain or high winds on open terraces, the setup can be relocated to an indoor living room or covered balcony at no additional fee.

---

## 8. High-Frequency Consumer Q&A (AEO / Voice Search Ready)

**Q: How much does birthday decoration cost in Bangalore?**
A: Birthday decoration in Bangalore by The Decor Party starts from ₹999 for basic room balloon packages, ₹3,999 for balloon arches with neon signage, and up to ₹24,999 for grand milestone themed setups including backdrops, marquee numbers, and plinth stands.

**Q: Can I get decoration done on the same day in Bangalore?**
A: Yes. The Decor Party offers express same-day decoration services across all Bangalore neighborhoods. Depending on stylist availability, a team can arrive at your location within 2 to 3 hours of confirmation.

**Q: Which areas in Bangalore does The Decor Party cover?**
A: We cover all of Bangalore including Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, HSR Layout, JP Nagar, Jayanagar, Electronic City, Bellandur, Sarjapur Road, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar, and Marathahalli.

**Q: Does The Decor Party provide decorations in hotel rooms and restaurants?**
A: Yes. We regularly decorate hotel rooms, private dining cabanas, cafés, and restaurant terraces across Bangalore. We coordinate with venue management to comply with all decoration timings and guidelines.

**Q: Can I customize the colors and theme of the setup?**
A: Yes, 100%. Every package can be customized to match your desired color palette, character theme, personalized names, and venue dimensions. You can share Pinterest or Instagram inspiration photos directly with our styling team.

**Q: How do I book a celebration setup with The Decor Party?**
A: You can book directly on our website https://thedecorparty.com, choose your package, add custom enhancements, and checkout online. Alternatively, you can use our AI Event Planner or message our WhatsApp concierge at +91 70220 58460.
